hook.line: No speech; a delivery box slides into an empty shop on its own.
hook.visual: Static shot of a shop doorway under a black 'KIRI BRAND CONTENT IDEAS #1236' title; a cardboard box slides in by itself, then a whip-pan blur.

beats.what: Empty shop floor and open door, series title on top
The box has slid in and stopped in the middle of the floor
Whip-pan blur carries the eye to the counter
Shop worker looks up from the counter at the box
Low angle from the box as she crouches and opens the flaps
POV from inside the box: her delighted face looking in
Reveal of product cans nested in kraft paper
Yellow doodle chair and 'THIS & A COLD BREW' stickers over the box

characters.enters: Slides through the open door by itself and stops mid-floor
characters.acts: Becomes the camera: we see her open it from the box's point of view
characters.exits: Opened to reveal the product, then covered by yellow doodle stickers

why_it_works: An object moving on its own in the first second breaks the scroll with no words needed
Point-of-view shots from inside the box make the viewer the parcel, so the reveal feels personal
A numbered series title (#1236) signals a repeatable idea format worth saving
Only 13 s, so the reveal lands before attention drops
weaknesses: No in-video call to action; the save ask lives only in the caption
Silent of speech, so the point (the product) relies on one sticker line at the end
for_robert: Let Fred enter like the box does, sliding into an empty frame on his own before Robert speaks, as a wordless first-second pattern interrupt.
